svg.title: Light use efficiency (GPP / PAR) from 14 days before to 28 days after the last day of a later silage cut (cut 2 or more), as a fraction of the LUE of the 14 days before the harvest: the normal group (6 cuts, mean and bootstrap 95 % CI) and the one cut in a dry month, Qvidja 2020-08-28 (SPI-1 −2.11).
svg.desc: One panel. X axis: days from the last day of the harvest (−14 to +28, local days, UTC+2). Y axis: LUE = GPP / PAR as a fraction of the LUE of the days −14 to −1 before the first day of the harvest, from −0.50 to 2.00; thin lines mark 1 and 0, an orange vertical line marks day 0 (the last day of the harvest). Markers every 7 days. Lines: normal group steel blue, solid, with circles, with the bootstrap 95 % CI band of the mean (drawn where 3 or more episodes have a value); the dry episode qvidja-2020-08-28 vermillion, dashed, with squares, no band (one episode). Normal episodes: anttila-2022-08-08, anttila-2023-07-19, qvidja-2018-09-23, qvidja-2019-08-20, qvidja-2023-08-21, sarkisuo-2022-08-15. Days +1 to +14: relative LUE dry 1.27 (SD n/a, n 1), normal 0.77 (95 % CI 0.49 to 1.18, n 6); the dry episode is 1.27 against the normal mean 0.77 (SD 0.49, range 0.40 to 1.72), 1.0 SD units; no test with one dry episode. Days +15 to +28: relative LUE dry 1.28 (SD n/a, n 1), normal 0.87 (95 % CI 0.75 to 1.00, n 4); the dry episode is 1.28 against the normal mean 0.87 (SD 0.15, range 0.74 to 1.06), 2.6 SD units; no test with one dry episode.
